title: LOOPHOUSE
description: Tools in circulation, work in common. A community workshop landing page with an interactive modular pegboard tool wall, magnetic dock unlatching, and live project tray staging.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · Interactive Pegboard · Clockwork Motion

sections.title: Machined Top Bar
sections.summary: Floating bar with brand lockup, live inventory telemetry (`428 tools in circulation · 98.4% return rate`), anchor navigation, and "Reserve a Kit" CTA.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: Perforated pegboard ground, split-line mask headline *"The neighborhood workshop on your block."*, lead copy, live status badge, and dual actions.

sections.title: The Pegboard Station (Mechanic)
sections.summary: Modular tool wall with category tabs, magnetic tool unlatching, caliper spec inspection, and active requisition tray.

sections.title: Circulation Route
sections.summary: Four-station workflow with drawn connector hairlines and stamped brass numbers (01 Requisition & Hold, 02 Locker or Bench Pickup, 03 Make & Maintain, 04 Calibrated Restock).

sections.title: Curated Project Kits
sections.summary: 4 heavy-duty packages (Cabinetmaker Joinery Pack, Timber Framing Rig, Electrician Diagnostics Caddy, Landscape Restoration Kit) with exploded tool manifests and loan duration pills.

sections.title: Workshop Ledger & Shelf Hosts
sections.summary: Operational metrics, host depot locations, member testimonials with badge numbers, and maintenance records.

sections.title: Requisition Intake & Bench Reservation Form
sections.summary: Client-side validated form (trade category, member email, loan days slider, workshop safety check) with instantaneous confirmation panel. Never send a network request.

sections.title: Colophon & Footer
sections.summary: Stamped iron mark, library regulations, copyright.

customCodeBlocks.title: LOOPHOUSE Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.
